theme: 教材片語・基礎 550–650 第 1 群

items.colloc: make a copy of 影印一份... | make extra copies 多印幾份
items.distinct: photocopy 影印機影本 | duplicate 副本
ex: Could you please make a copy of this report?
你能幫我把這份報告影印一份嗎？
I need to make a copy for the accounting department.
我需要為會計部門做一份影印副本。
Please make a copy before you hand in the file.
繳交檔案之前請先影印一份。

items.colloc: depend on someone 依賴某人 | depend on the situation 取決於情況
items.distinct: rely on 依賴；信賴 | count on 指望
ex: Our success will depend on the marketing strategy.
我們的成功將取決於行銷策略。
The delivery time depends on your specific location.
配送時間取決於您的具體地點。
We cannot always depend on one single supplier.
我們不能總是依賴單一供應商。

items.colloc: have in common 有共同點 | nothing in common 毫無共同點
items.distinct: shared 分享的；共享的 | mutual 互相的
ex: Both companies have a lot in common culturally.
兩家公司在企業文化上有許多共同點。
We have nothing in common regarding our business goals.
我們在商業目標上毫無共同點。
They found they had much in common during the meeting.
會議中他們發現彼此有許多共同點。

items.colloc: make payment by check 以支票付款 | make payment online 線上付款
items.distinct: settle the bill 結帳 | pay off 還清債務
ex: Please make payment within thirty days of purchase.
請於購買後三十天內完成付款。
You can make payment through our secure portal.
您可以透過我們的安全入口網站付款。
Failure to make payment will result in a penalty.
未完成付款將會導致罰款。

items.colloc: book in advance 事先預訂 | payment in advance 預付
items.distinct: ahead of time 提前 | beforehand 事先
ex: Please notify us in advance if you cannot attend.
如果您無法出席請事先通知我們。
All tickets must be purchased in advance online.
所有票券都必須事先在網上購買。
It is better to prepare the slides in advance.
最好能事先準備好簡報投影片。

items.pos: phr. 代表；作為...的代理人
items.colloc: on behalf of the company 代表公司 | on behalf of the team 代表團隊
items.distinct: represent 代表 | in the name of 以...的名義
ex: I am signing this contract on behalf of my boss.
我正代表我的老闆簽署這份合約。
She accepted the award on behalf of the staff.
她代表員工接受了這項獎項。
The lawyer spoke on behalf of the accused client.
律師代表被告客戶發言。

items.colloc: pick up a package 領取包裹 | pick up a client 接客戶
items.distinct: collect 收集；領取 | gather 聚集
ex: I will pick up the documents from the reception.
我會去櫃檯領取文件。
The driver will pick up the guest at noon.
司機會在中午去接那位客人。
Please pick up your badge at the registration desk.
請在報到處領取您的識別證。

items.colloc: look forward to hearing from you 期待收到您的回信 | look forward to working with you 期待與您合作
items.distinct: anticipate 預期（較正式或指預感）| expect 預期（指認定會發生）
ex: I look forward to our meeting next week.
我期待下週與您會面。
The team looks forward to finishing the project.
團隊很期待完成這個專案。
We look forward to your attendance at the gala.
我們期待您出席晚宴。

items.colloc: point out a mistake 指出錯誤 | point out a problem 指出問題
items.distinct: indicate 表明；標示 | remark 評論；談論
ex: The manager pointed out a flaw in the plan.
經理指出了計畫中的一個瑕疵。
She pointed out that the deadline was near.
她指出截止日期快到了。
He pointed out several errors in the report.
他指出了報告中的幾處錯誤。

items.colloc: deal with a complaint 處理投訴 | deal with a crisis 處理危機
items.distinct: handle 處理（指操作或應對）| address 處理（指對問題採取行動）
ex: Our department deals with all customer inquiries.
我們部門處理所有客戶諮詢。
How will you deal with this sudden change?
你打算如何處理這個突發變更？
He is experienced in dealing with difficult clients.
他很有處理困難客戶的經驗。

items.colloc: carry out research 進行研究 | carry out a task 執行任務
items.distinct: execute 執行（指令或計畫）| implement 實施（政策或系統）
ex: The agency will carry out a market survey.
該代理商將進行一項市場調查。
Staff members carry out instructions from the CEO.
員工們執行執行長的指示。
We must carry out the safety protocols correctly.
我們必須正確執行安全規範。

items.colloc: fill in a form 填寫表格 | fill in the gaps 補齊空缺
items.distinct: fill out 填寫（全部資訊） | complete 完成
ex: Please fill in your name on the guest list.
請在訪客名單上填寫您的姓名。
Can you fill in for me at the board meeting?
你能幫我參加董事會議並補充說明嗎？
Fill in the required information on this document.
請在這份文件上填寫必要的資訊。

items.colloc: fill out an application 填寫申請表 | fill out the survey 填寫問卷
items.distinct: fill in 填寫（細節） | write down 寫下
ex: You need to fill out this form to apply.
你需要填寫這份表格來申請。
Please fill out the feedback survey before leaving today.
請在今天離開前填寫意見回饋問卷。
All employees must fill out their tax forms annually.
所有員工必須每年填寫稅務表格。

items.colloc: traditionally held 傳統上舉行 | traditionally associated 傳統上相關
items.distinct: customarily 慣例上 | conventionally 慣例地
ex: This industry is traditionally dominated by large corporations.
這個產業傳統上由大型企業主導。
The company meeting is traditionally held every January.
公司會議傳統上在每年一月舉行。
They traditionally provide bonuses at the end of year.
他們傳統上會在年底發放獎金。

items.colloc: take part in the meeting 參加會議 | take part in the project 參與專案
items.distinct: participate in 參與（正式）| join 加入（社團/活動）
ex: All department heads will take part in the strategy meeting.
所有部門主管都將參加策略會議。
We encourage employees to take part in the training program.
我們鼓勵員工參與這項培訓計畫。
She decided to take part in the annual business conference.
她決定參加年度商業研討會。

items.colloc: misplace a file 弄丟文件 | misplace an item 弄丟物品
items.distinct: lose 遺失（指完全找不著）| mislay 隨手放置到找不到
ex: I must have misplaced the important document.
我一定是把那份重要文件弄丟了。
Please do not misplace the login credentials.
請不要把登入憑證隨意放置。
She realized she had misplaced her office key.
她發現她弄丟了辦公室鑰匙。

items.colloc: a man of action 有執行力的人 | a man of experience 經驗豐富的人
items.distinct: staff 員工 | employee 受雇者
ex: He is a man of great integrity in business.
他在商場上是一位非常有操守的人。
We need a man for the maintenance team immediately.
我們現在需要一位男性加入維修團隊。
That man is the new consultant for our project.
那位先生是我們專案的新任顧問。

items.pos: v. 收費；充電 | n. 費用；負責
items.colloc: free of charge 免費 | in charge of 負責
items.distinct: fee 費用 | cost 成本
ex: The hotel will charge for the extra room service.
飯店會針對額外的客房服務收費。
Who is in charge of the training program?
誰負責這個培訓計畫？
There is no charge for the initial consultation service.
初次諮詢服務不收取任何費用。

items.colloc: work out a solution 想出解決方案 | work out the details 釐清細節
items.distinct: solve 解決（指難題）| figure out 理解；算出
ex: We need to work out a new budget plan.
我們需要制定一份新的預算計畫。
The accountants are working out the total costs.
會計師們正在計算總成本。
Things will work out if we stay focused.
如果我們保持專注，事情會有轉機。

items.pos: phr. 易受…影響；需服從於
items.colloc: be subject to change 需待更改 | be subject to approval 需經批准
items.distinct: be prone to 易於（負面）| be liable to 有風險的
ex: This project schedule is subject to change without prior notice.
本專案行程表可能隨時更改，不另行通知。
All purchase orders are subject to manager approval first.
所有採購單皆須先經過經理批准。
The company policy is subject to review every six months.
公司政策每半年需進行審查一次。
